name: UniShine Shop Assist — AI Chatbot
author: unishine

sections.description:
The Easiest AI ChatBot for WordPress

Tired of missing customer inquiries? Install UniShine Shop Assist and connect it to your free UniShine AI account. Your AI assistant will work 24/7 to engage visitors and answer questions based on your knowledge.

Why Choose This Plugin?

  • 1-Minute Setup: Just install, get a free API key, paste it, and you’re done.
  • Truly Free Tier: Start with 50 Q/A pairs, 5,000 words, and 200 chats/month at no cost.
  • Seamless Upgrade: Need more? Upgrade seamlessly within the plugin to unlock 500+ Q/A pairs, 50k words, and 5,000 chats/month.
  • Fully Customizable: Match your brand with theme colors, positions, and chat title.

Perfect For

  • Small business websites
  • WooCommerce stores
  • Portfolio and service sites
  • Blogs and content publishers
  • Anyone who wants instant customer support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the unishine-shop-assist folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to UniShine Shop Assist in your admin menu, click the link to get your FREE API Key.
  4. Paste the API Key and URL into the settings page and save.
  5. The chat button will appear on your site! 💬
sections.faq:
Is there really a free plan?

Yes! Sign up on our platform for a free account that includes 50 Q/A pairs, 5,000 total words, and 200 chats per month.

How do I get more features?

Inside the plugin settings, you’ll see your usage. When you need more, click the “Upgrade to Pro” button to get 10x more capacity and advanced features for $29/month.

Can I customize the look?

Absolutely. You can change the chat button position (bottom-right, bottom-left, etc.), theme color, and the assistant’s name.
